params.prompt: Photo-real establishing shot for a Korean sitcom, 9:16 vertical, evening. Wide shot from the entrance side at eye level, the sofa in the foreground-left and the kitchen island in the midground-right, both fully visible. Reference image 2 gives the two people: keep their exact faces, hair, glasses and clothes. The man (navy overshirt, round gold glasses, ID badge) sits on the sofa holding a phone in both hands looking down. Behind the island a Nepali man (31, deep brown skin, black curly hair, short beard, white chef jacket, beige towel on shoulder, navy half-apron) stands holding a glass pickle jar.
